name: SnowLuma
description: OpenClaw channel plugin connecting QQ via the SnowLuma SDK. Speaks to SnowLuma exclusively through @snowluma/sdk (WebSocket + action client); never reimplements the OneBot protocol on the wire.

snowluma.label: SnowLuma
snowluma.description: QQ messaging via the SnowLuma SDK — mention/keyword, digest, and realtime receive modes, plus active quote/forward-message resolution.

enabled.description: Enable this SnowLuma account. Default: true.

wsUrl.description: SnowLuma OneBot WebSocket URL, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:3001/.

httpUrl.description: Optional HTTP API URL. When set, actions go over HTTP instead of the socket.

selfId.description: Bot's own QQ number. Auto-detected via get_login_info when omitted.

allowFrom.description: Allowed peers, e.g. ["private:123", "group:456", "*"]. Unset allows everyone.

denyFrom.description: Denied peers; evaluated after allowFrom and always wins.

groupAutoReact.description: React to inbound group messages that trigger the agent. Default: false.

groupAutoReactEmojiId.description: QQ emoji id used for groupAutoReact. Default: 1.

replyToTrigger.description: Send replies as QQ quote-replies to the triggering message. Default: true.

textChunkLimit.description: Split outbound text into chunks of at most this many characters. Default: 4500.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Request timeout for SnowLuma actions, in ms. Default: 30000.

debug.description: Debug mode: log the raw payload of every outbound message the plugin sends. Default: false.

enabled.description: Enable the SDK's built-in WebSocket reconnect. Default: true.

retries.description: Max reconnect attempts. Omit for unlimited retries; an explicit number — including 0, meaning never retry — is honoured as written.

minDelayMs.description: Minimum delay between reconnect attempts, in ms. Default: 1000.

maxDelayMs.description: Maximum delay between reconnect attempts, in ms. Default: 30000.

reconnect.description: Reconnect tuning handed to the SDK's WebSocket client.

mention.description: Reply the moment a message is addressed at the bot: an explicit @bot mention or a configured keyword hit.

enabled.description: Enable the mention/keyword trigger. Default: true.

requireMentionInGroup.description: Require an @bot mention in group chats. Default: true.

keywords.description: Keywords that trigger a reply without an @bot mention. Default: [].

keywordMatch.description: How keywords are matched against the message text. Default: contains.

triggerOnReplyToSelf.description: Treat a reply to one of the bot's own messages as a trigger. Default: true.

alwaysReplyInDirect.description: Always reply in direct (private) chats, mention or not. Default: true.

digest.description: Periodically summarise what a chat has been talking about. Fires when intervalMs elapses or maxMessages accumulate, whichever comes first; suppressed below minMessages.

intervalMs.description: Flush the window after this many milliseconds. Default: 300000 (5 min).

maxMessages.description: Flush the window once this many messages have accumulated. Default: 50.

minMessages.description: Never flush a window holding fewer messages than this (internally capped to maxMessages). Default: 3.

prompt.description: Instruction prepended to the transcript when dispatching. Default: the plugin's built-in Chinese digest prompt asking for a concise summary, or SKIP if nothing is worth reporting.

scope.description: Which chats to observe. Default: group.

peers.description: Only observe these peers (e.g. group:123). Empty/omitted means all peers in scope.

maxTranscriptChars.description: Hard cap on transcript characters handed to the agent. Default: 20000.

realtime.description: Coalesce a burst of messages that arrive within a sub-second window into one agent turn, then answer immediately.

windowMs.description: Quiet period before flushing, in ms; timer resets on each new message. Must stay under 1000ms to remain 'realtime'. Default: 800.

maxWindowMs.description: Absolute ceiling on how long a burst may be held open, in ms. Default: 3000.

maxMessages.description: Flush immediately once this many messages are buffered. Default: 10.

maxChars.description: Flush immediately once the buffered text exceeds this many characters. Default: 8000.

history.description: Rolling per-peer buffer of recent messages, kept separately from the digest queue and handed to each triggered reply as historical chat context, then drained.

enabled.description: Accumulate recent messages per peer and include them as context when a reply is triggered. Default: true.

maxMessages.description: Max messages of history kept per peer. Default: 20.

maxChars.description: Max total characters of history kept and injected per peer. Default: 4000.

maxAgeMs.description: Drop history messages older than this many ms (by QQ timestamp) at snapshot time. 0 disables the age limit. Default: 0.

receive.description: Receive modes (mention/keyword, digest, realtime coalescing) plus the reply-history buffer.

quote.description: Active quote / merged-forward resolution via get_msg and get_forward_msg.

enabled.description: Actively fetch quoted messages via get_msg. Default: true.

resolveForward.description: Expand merged-forward payloads via get_forward_msg. Default: true.

maxDepth.description: How deep to follow nested forwards. Default: 2.

maxNodes.description: Cap on forwarded nodes rendered per forward. Default: 20.

maxChars.description: Cap on characters of resolved quote text injected into the body. Default: 4000.

enabled.description: Register the plugin's agent tools (snowluma_get_history, snowluma_get_group_members). Default: true.

tools.description: Agent tool registration for this account.

accounts.description: Additional named SnowLuma accounts, keyed by account id.

additionalProperties.description: One additional named SnowLuma account under channels.snowluma.accounts.<id>.
